# Preserve and reconcile nzmedicines history and files

**Parent:** https://github.com/edithatogo/global-medicines-atlas/issues/1  
**GitHub issue:** https://github.com/edithatogo/global-medicines-atlas/issues/2  
**Conductor phase:** Phase 1  
**Requirements:** M-020, M-021, M-022, M-023

## Acceptance criteria

- Complete Git bundle verifies.
- Every upstream file has a digest and disposition.
- Existing local NZULM/NZMT files are inventoried.
- No local file is overwritten by import.
- Conflicts and richer local capabilities are recorded.
